name: rq6-dev
description:
RQ6, development data: GLiNER fine-tuned here (train-cs-sk-ce, train-cs-sk-focal) against
GLiNER zero-shot as shipped and NameTag 3 (Czech, multilingual), the opponent, each beside
the rules, on every development split. NameTag 3 Czech is trained on CNEC train and the
models trained here on OpenPII train, so CNEC and OpenPII favour one side each; UNER-SK and
REDACT favour neither. Train the two models first (python -m experiments train); they are
found under the resource root.
